svg.title: Forensic scientist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as forensic scientist, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A sealed evidence envelope is paired with a long sampling swab with a rounded cotton tip. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
